speaker: Doctor
text: That history of partial labial fusion and clitoromegaly alongside your mother's hirsutism strongly suggests a congenital androgen excess syndrome. Did you also experience excessive hair growth on your face or body during childhood, and have you noticed any widening of your jaw or gum overgrowth? REQUEST TEST: Serum 17-hydroxyprogesterone, DHEA-S, and testosterone levels.
